Model.Name: Automated Identification and Measurement of NT (AIM-NT)
Model.Purpose: To develop and evaluate an artificial intelligence–based model for real-time nuchal translucency (NT) plane identification and measurement in prenatal US assessments.
Model.Description: The Automated Identification and Measurement of Nuchal Translucency (AIM-NT) model is an artificial intelligence–based tool developed using the You Only Look Once version 7 (YOLOv7) and Residual Neural Network (ResNet) frameworks to automatically identify the nuchal translucency (NT) plane and measure NT thickness in prenatal US imaging. The model integrates three specialized modules: a plane-scoring module, an anatomic structure detection module, and an NT measurement module.

Outputs.Description: Identification of standard vs nonstandard nuchal translucency (NT) plane.
